title: File tree
description: Files and folders as a keyboard tree, with A / M / D marks for what an agent added, modified or deleted; select a file to open it.
when: Changes an agent made, a repo or export browser, attachments with folders.
a11y: role="tree" with treeitems (aria-level, aria-expanded, aria-selected); ↑/↓, →/← open and close, Home / End, Enter selects; change marks have text for screen readers.
